nodes.description: bool public paused; mint kill-switch flag checked at the start of mint().
uint256 public cost = 0.02 ether; price per minted FISHTANK used in the payment check.
uint256 public maxFISHTANK = 4800; hard cap on minted supply.
uint256 public maxMintAmount = 20; per-transaction mint limit.
string public baseURI = 'https://ipfs.io/ipfs/Qm...'; metadata prefix returned by _baseURI().
string public baseExtension = '.json'; appended to token URI.
Counters.Counter private _tokenCount; tracks number of minted tokens in WithLimitedSupply.
mapping(uint256 => uint256) private tokenMatrix; pseudo-random index assignment storage.
uint256 private startFrom; initial token id offset (1) for RandomlyAssigned.
uint256 private _maxSupply; maximum token count configured in WithLimitedSupply.
mint(uint256) public payable: validates paused/mintAmount/supply/payment then loops calling nextToken() and _safeMint().
withdraw() public payable onlyOwner: sends the whole contract balance to msg.sender via low-level send().
walletOfOwner(address) view: returns all token ids owned by an address.
tokenURI(uint256) view: builds baseURI + tokenId + baseExtension.
_baseURI() internal view: returns the baseURI state variable.
nextToken() internal override in RandomlyAssigned: pseudo-random index from block values, updates tokenMatrix and counter.
constructor of StupidFishTank: ERC721('Stupid Fish Tank','FISHTANK') and RandomlyAssigned(4800,1).
availableTokenCount() view: maxSupply() - tokenCount(), used by availability modifiers.
ensureAvailability() modifier in WithLimitedSupply requiring availableTokenCount() > 0.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): caller-controlled address used for mint recipient and withdraw beneficiary.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value mixed into the randomness seed of nextToken().
Weak pseudo-randomness: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit, block.timestamp)) % maxIndex.
payable(msg.sender).send(address(this).balance): unchecked low-level send of full balance in withdraw().
Arithmetic cost * _mintAmount used in the payment requirement of mint().
_safeMint() triggers IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient contract, re-entering external code before the mint loop completes.
uint256 _mintAmount: user-supplied number of tokens to mint.
address _owner: address queried by walletOfOwner().
uint256 tokenId: token queried by tokenURI().
uint256 mintIndex: token id returned by nextToken() inside the mint loop.
uint256 i: loop counter in mint() bounded by _mintAmount.
string currentBaseURI: cached _baseURI() result in tokenURI().
uint256 ownerTokenCount: balanceOf(_owner) used to size the tokenIds array.
uint256 random: pseudo-random index derived from block values in nextToken().
uint256 maxIndex: maxSupply() - tokenCount() used as the random modulo bound.

edges.reason: _mintAmount parameter drives all validation and the mint loop of mint().
paused flag gates execution of mint() via require(!paused).
maxMintAmount bounds _mintAmount inside mint().
maxFISHTANK bounds totalSupply()+_mintAmount inside mint().
cost state variable is multiplied by _mintAmount in the payment check.
_mintAmount participates in the cost * _mintAmount arithmetic.
mint() performs the cost * _mintAmount computation on the user-controlled amount.
mint() calls nextToken() on every loop iteration.
_safeMint() inside the mint loop makes an external callback to the recipient contract.
onERC721Received on a malicious recipient can re-enter mint() before state finalization.
loop counter i (1.._mintAmount) controls repeated mint iterations.
mintIndex produced by nextToken() is passed to _safeMint().
msg.sender (_msgSender()) is the recipient supplied to _safeMint().
nextToken() reads and increments _tokenCount.
nextToken() reads and writes tokenMatrix for index assignment.
nextToken() computes its randomness seed from miner-influenceable block values.
block.timestamp is hashed into the randomness seed, making the result timestamp dependent.
availableTokenCount() subtracts tokenCount() from _maxSupply.
_tokenCount current value feeds availableTokenCount().
ensureAvailability modifier on nextToken() checks availableTokenCount() > 0.
withdraw() sends the whole balance to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
withdraw() executes the low-level send of the contract balance.
_baseURI() returns the baseURI state variable.
baseExtension is concatenated into the token URI.
currentBaseURI local is built into the returned URI string.
tokenId parameter is used for the _exists check and string conversion.
_owner parameter drives balanceOf and token enumeration.
ownerTokenCount sizes and bounds the returned tokenIds array.
maxIndex is the modulo bound used to derive the random index.
nextToken() computes the random local and stores it in tokenMatrix.

normalization_plan.reason: The _mintAmount parameter has no independent semantics outside mint(); its checks and loop belong to the mint() core function.
The _owner parameter is only consumed by walletOfOwner() and should be folded into that core function.
The tokenId parameter is only consumed by tokenURI() and should be folded into that core function.
mintIndex is a temporary holder for the value returned by nextToken() used inside mint()'s loop.
The loop counter i exists solely to drive the mint() iteration and has no separate meaning.
currentBaseURI is a local cache of _baseURI() used only to build the tokenURI() result.
ownerTokenCount is a local balance cache used only by walletOfOwner().
The random local is the direct product of the weak randomness unsafe operation and should be merged into it.
maxIndex is an intermediate bound value used only by nextToken()'s index assignment logic.
